definitions.gloss: hot spring cure; therapeutic bathing at a hot spring
definitions.explanation: The practice of staying at a hot spring for an extended period to treat illness or promote health. A traditional Japanese form of convalescence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{湯治|とうじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take a hot spring cure.

examples.english: This hot spring, famous as a therapeutic bathing destination, has many long-term guests.

notes:
{湯治|とうじ} is the traditional practice of staying at a hot spring for an extended period to treat illness or restore health.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- A practice with centuries of history in Japan: people would stay for days or weeks at therapeutic ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ resorts to recover from chronic ailments, rheumatism, skin conditions, or general fatigue.
- Famous {湯治|とうじ} towns include {草津|くさつ} (Gunma), {鳴子|なるこ} (Miyagi), and {四万|しま} (Gunma).
- Modern day-trip hot-spring visits are not {湯治|とうじ}; the term specifically implies extended stays for health purposes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {湯治|とうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go for a hot-spring cure)
- {湯治|とうじ}⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧: a therapeutic hot-spring resort
- {湯治|とうじ}⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: a guest who stays for a hot-spring cure
- {湯治|とうじ}⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧: an inn that caters to long-term therapeutic guests

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: hot-spring therapy (the modern medical term).
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: a regular hot-spring trip (not therapeutic).
- Note the homophones ⟦{冬至|とうじ}→冬至：11756_touji⟧ (winter solstice) and ⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧ (at that time), which are written with different kanji.
